SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

4. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   C. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Communicatio n in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Traditional forms of Government and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
